justification: Both surfaces depict human figures, and B's principal motif appears to be a stick-like anthropomorph with splayed limbs, loosely comparable to A's standing men only at the most generic level. A shows a dense, naturalistic procession of robed, bearded figures in profile who touch, lead and hold hands and objects in a strict horizontal register, whereas B shows sparse, isolated linear scratches with no discernible costume, attributes, register or interaction.
